Title: LangSmith CI/CD Example
Description:
This shows how to setup CI/CD for a LangSmith Deployment
• unit, integration, e2e tests
• offline evaluations with https://github.com/langchain-ai/openevals and https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/home
• preview and prod agent deployments using https://docs.langchain.com/langgraph-platform/api-ref-control-plane control plane API

Title: Multi-Supervisor Commerce Agent
Description: A simple multi-agent ecommerce system built with LangChain and LangGraph. A top-level supervisor routes customer queries to specialized business unit (BU) supervisors that focus on billing & payments, order management, and promotions & loyalty tasks.

Title: LangSmith On-Demand Agent Auth
Description: This project demonstrates the new Agent OAuth Authentication capabilities in LangSmith, showcasing how to build intelligent agents that can securely authenticate with external services like GitHub and access user data on-demand.

Title: LS Multi-Project Tracing
Description: A LangGraph agent that routes LangSmith traces to different workspaces based on configuration. Perfect for multi-tenant applications or testing across different environments.

Title: LangSmith MCP Auth
Description: End-to-end example of user authentication for LangGraph agents that interact with MCP servers using individual user credentials.

Title: Distributed Tracing [Remote Graph]
Description: This example demonstrates proper implementation of distributed tracing between a supervisor (parent) graph and a subagent (child/remote) graph using LangGraph.

Title: LangGraph Fault Tolerance
Description: Demonstrates LangGraph's fault tolerance mechanism using pending writes to handle partial failures in parallel execution workflows.

Title: LangSmith PII Removal
Description: To demonstrate the various ways that users can mask PII using the LangSmith SDK
